test_title: PYST 54: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 04 Oct, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
The following sentence has been split into four segments. Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error.

It is take / a couple of minutes / for the computer / to boot up.
solution:
The correct answer is '**It is take****'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given sentence, "**It is take**" is grammatically incorrect.
 
• '**Is**' is the helping verb and '**take**' is the main verb.
 
• The helping verb '**is**' is used with the main verb only in the passive voice.
 
• '**It**' is the subject in the given sentence which should be directly used with the main verb 'take'

Therefore, the correct answer is 'Option 4'.

**Correct Sentence**: **It takes** a couple of minutes for the computer to boot up.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• In the passive voice, 'is' is used with the main verb 
 
 
• **Example**- An apple is eaten by me.
